footerTagline: Building & Connecting People with Privacy & Security.
heroDescription: We build thoughtful Android applications and explore next-generation ideas in artificial intelligence, privacy and security — creating technology that puts people first.
heroCommitmentLine: Useful by design. Private by principle.
journeyTitle: Your data. Your choice. Your control.
journeyIntro: A simplified view of the privacy risks people can face online — and the privacy-first direction we are exploring with SafeMobile.
journeyStep1Text: When you use an app or service, information may travel across networks and services.
journeyStep2Text: Third-party trackers and profiling technologies may observe activity across apps and websites.
journeyStep3Text: Our planned SafeMobile experience is being researched to help identify and interrupt suspicious activity. It is not yet released.
journeyStep4Text: Clear choices, privacy-conscious defaults and transparent controls should keep people in charge.
journeyFootnote: Illustrative privacy journey, not a description of a currently released SafeMobile protection feature.
aboutDescription: We are building useful digital products and exploring responsible technology — connecting people with the tools they need while keeping privacy and security in focus.
productsDescription: A growing collection of thoughtful digital tools — from everyday Android utilities to research-led privacy and security initiatives.
safeTitle: Safer mobile experiences, designed around privacy.
safeDescription: SafeMobile is our research initiative exploring a privacy-conscious Android security experience. We are investigating device risk insights, financial safety awareness and on-device intelligence.
contactDescription: Have a question about our apps, research or company? Send us a message. We would be glad to hear from you.

researchDescription: We explore how intelligent systems and privacy-conscious engineering can create safer, more useful digital experiences.
